sentences.en: It's 18 miles in circumference and 10 feet high.
sentences.zh: 它周长18英里，高10英尺。

sentences.en: You know, it's a really, if it was standing today, you'd go and see it as it would be a tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这真的是，如果它今天还立在那里，你一定会去参观，它会是一个旅游景点。

sentences.en: Anyway, it's not standing because the crowd demolished the wall and they demolished 40 customs posts, which are intervals around the wall, and they burn all the records
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，它已经不在了，因为人群拆毁了这堵墙，还拆毁了沿墙每隔一段距离设立的40个海关卡哨，并烧毁了所有来自

sentences.en: from the customs posts.
sentences.zh: 海关卡哨的档案记录。

sentences.en: Now, burning the records, people are doing this in the countryside at the same time.
sentences.zh: 烧毁档案这件事，人们在乡下也在同时进行着。

sentences.en: They're breaking into castles and things.
sentences.zh: 他们闯入城堡之类的地方。

sentences.en: It's very like the Peasants' Revolt.
sentences.zh: 这非常像农民起义。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全没错。

sentences.en: Burning the feudal records.
sentences.zh: 烧毁封建档案。

sentences.en: The evidence, as it were, of their own subordinate status.
sentences.zh: 也就是他们从属地位的证据。

sentences.en: So this is what people are doing outside Paris.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是巴黎城外的人们在做的事。

sentences.en: And they're doing this all night.
sentences.zh: 而且他们整晚都在这么做。

sentences.en: Now, back inside the city, of course, there are a lot of people with a lot to lose.
sentences.zh: 现在，回到城内，当然有许多人有着巨大的利益要失去。

sentences.en: There are the properted middle classes, basically the people who up till now have been directing the revolutionary process.
sentences.zh: 这里是有产中产阶级，基本上是那些直到现在一直在领导革命进程的人。

sentences.en: And a lot of them are extremely worried about the fact that the army has vacated the city and law and order is completely breaking down.
sentences.zh: 他们当中有很多人极其担心，因为军队已经撤出了城市，法律与秩序彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: And there's a group of royal officials that huddle around a guy who's effectively the mayor.
sentences.zh: 有一群王室官员聚集在一个实际上担任市长职务的人周围。

sentences.en: He's called the
sentences.zh: 他被称为

sentences.en: Provost of Merchants, the Prévost de Marchand.
sentences.zh: 商会教务长，即巴黎商会会长。

sentences.en: His name is Jacques de Flessel, and we will come back to him at the end of this episode.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫雅克·德·弗莱塞尔，我们将在本集末尾再次提到他。

sentences.en: Spoiler alert, he does not come to a very happy end.
sentences.zh: 剧透一下，他的结局并不是很好。

sentences.en: And the mayor basically says, listen, we need to kind of rally the forces of order.
sentences.zh: 市长基本上说，听着，我们需要把维护秩序的力量重新集结起来。

sentences.en: And we will do this at dawn on the 13th of July.
sentences.zh: 我们将在7月13日黎明时分这样做。

sentences.en: We'll sound the toxin.
sentences.zh: 我们会敲响警钟。

sentences.en: The churches, the bells will toll an emergency signal.
sentences.zh: 教堂的钟声将敲响紧急信号。

sentences.en: We'll fire cannons.
sentences.zh: 我们会鸣放礼炮。

sentences.en: There will be druMs.
sentences.zh: 会有鼓声。

sentences.en: And these will call out representatives from the electoral districts to the Hôtel de Ville, the city hall, and we will meet and we will decide what to do.
sentences.zh: 这些将把各选区的代表召集到市政厅，我们会开会决定该怎么做。

sentences.en: And presumably this will have a very calming effect on everyone else.
sentences.zh: 想必这对其他人会产生非常强烈的安抚作用。

sentences.en: This is what they're hoping, yeah, madness.
sentences.zh: 这是他们的愿望，真是疯狂。

sentences.en: Because as soon as the toxin starts tolling at dawn...
sentences.zh: 因为就在黎明警钟敲响的那一刻...

sentences.en: Yeah, bells and cannon.
sentences.zh: 对，钟声和大炮。

sentences.en: ...people are like, what's going on?
sentences.zh: ...人们会想，发生什么事了？

sentences.en: And everyone pours out into the streets thinking the city's under attack from the army or who knows what.
sentences.zh: 所有人都涌上街头，以为这座城市正遭到军队袭击，或者天知道是谁在袭击。

sentences.en: Now at the Hôtel de Ville, the representatives of the electoral districts arrive and they agree
sentences.zh: 现在在市政厅，各选区的代表们到达了，他们同意

sentences.en: to form a commune, a sort of an informal city administration to run their own affairs.
sentences.zh: 组建一个公社，一种非正式的城市管理机构来管理他们自己的事务。

sentences.en: The commune will become one of the great power bases in the French Revolution, although nobody, of course, knows this at the time.
sentences.zh: 公社将成为法国大革命中伟大的权力基地之一，当然当时谁也不知道这一点。

sentences.en: And they also say there are now mobs roaming the streets.
sentences.zh: 他们还说，现在街上有暴民在游荡。

sentences.en: There are also bands of vigilantes roaming the streets.
sentences.zh: 街上也有治安维持会的人在游荡。

sentences.en: We should regularise all this with a militia.
sentences.zh: 我们应该用民兵把这一切规范化。

sentences.en: They call it, entertainingly, the garde bourgeois, the bourgeois guard.
sentences.zh: 他们给它取了一个有趣的称呼，国民近卫军，资产阶级卫队。

sentences.en: And this is what becomes, ultimately, the National Guard.
sentences.zh: 这就是最终成为国民自卫军的组织。

sentences.en: Again, a key player in the revolutionary story.
sentences.zh: 同样，这也是革命故事中的一个关键角色。

sentences.en: And they've been wearing, of course, Camille Desmoulins' green sprigs.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们一直佩戴着卡米尔·德穆兰的绿枝。

sentences.en: Green sprigs, exactly.
sentences.zh: 绿枝，没错。

sentences.en: And they say, well, this green business is rubbish.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这绿色的玩意儿简直一无是处。

sentences.en: Not least because green is the symbol of one of the great reactionaries, the king's brother, the comte d'artois.
sentences.zh: 尤其是因为绿色是其中一位大反动派——国王的弟弟阿图瓦伯爵的象征。

sentences.en: And they don't we wear the colours of Paris, red and blue.
sentences.zh: 他们不佩戴巴黎的颜色——红色和蓝色。

sentences.en: So, that morning, they swapped their cockades for red and blue cockades.
sentences.zh: 所以，那天早上，他们把帽徽换成了红蓝两色的帽徽。

sentences.en: We will discuss the symbolism of cockades a little bit later.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会讨论帽徽的象征意义。

sentences.en: So, meanwhile, the anarchy in the streets is actually getting worse.
sentences.zh: 所以，与此同时，街头的无政府状态实际上正在恶化。

sentences.en: That morning, rioters sacked the convent of Saint-Lazare.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，暴徒洗劫了圣拉扎尔修道院。

sentences.en: Which is where Beaumarchais had been imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 博马舍曾被关押在那里。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: A nice nod back to your thing about the marriage of Figaro, Tom.
sentences.zh: 这很好地呼应了你刚才讲的关于《费加罗的婚礼》的事情，汤姆。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They find there a lot of food.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里找到了大量食物。

sentences.en: Wine, vinegar, 25 Gruyere cheeses, which is exactly what I'd expect to be in a monastery, frankly.
sentences.zh: 葡萄酒、醋、25个格鲁耶尔奶酪，坦率地说，这正是我期望在修道院里找到的东西。

sentences.en: And a large, dried ram's head.
sentences.zh: 还有一个巨大的风干公羊头。

sentences.en: I mean, who knows what you'd be doing with that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁知道你会用它来做什么？

sentences.en: Is that the basis for a soup?
sentences.zh: 那是做汤的底料吗？

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Well, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, so monasteries and convents are always the setting for pornographic fantasies.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，修道院历来是色情幻想的发生地。

sentences.en: They are.
sentences.zh: 确实是的。

sentences.en: They all see our regime.
sentences.zh: 他们都看到了我们的政权。

sentences.en: So, who knows what's going on there?
sentences.zh: 所以，谁知道那里发生了什么？

sentences.en: About cheese.
sentences.zh: 关于奶酪。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, anyway, they take all this stuff and they say, oh, well, this absolutely proves the privileged classes, the monks, the priests, the bigwigs have been hoarding food all this
sentences.zh: 所以，无论如何，他们拿走了所有这些东西，并说，哦，这绝对证明了特权阶层，修士、神父、大人物们一直在囤积食物

sentences.en: time.
sentences.zh: 这么久。

sentences.en: And that's, of course, only inflames them more.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只会让他们更加愤怒。

sentences.en: Now, they're desperate to get weapons because they think they're going to come under attack.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们迫切想要武器，因为他们认为自己将遭到袭击。

sentences.en: They ransack a royal storehouse.
sentences.zh: 他们洗劫了一个皇家仓库。

sentences.en: They get loads of halberds.
sentences.zh: 他们弄到了大量的戟。

sentences.en: We had a few halberds in our British Elections episode, so it's great to have halberds back on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在英国大选那一集里提到过几把戟，所以很高兴能让戟再次出现在节目中。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Crossbows.
sentences.zh: 弩。

sentences.en: They've got a cannon that was given by the King of Siam to Louis XIV.
sentences.zh: 他们有一门暹罗国王送给路易十四的大炮。

sentences.en: What a detail.
sentences.zh: 多么棒的细节。

sentences.en: A silver-lined cannon.
sentences.zh: 一门镶银的大炮。

sentences.en: It was basically a toy, a toy cannon, life-size toy cannon.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是个玩具，一个玩具大炮，真人大小的玩具大炮。

sentences.en: Anyway, they've got this cannon.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，他们弄到了这门大炮。

sentences.en: I like to think decorated with elephants, do you think?
sentences.zh: 我愿意想象上面装饰着大象，你觉得呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, almost certainly.
sentences.zh: 对，几乎可以肯定。

sentences.en: They go to the great sort of military hospital, Les Invalides.
sentences.zh: 他们去了那个巨大的军事医院，荣军院。

sentences.en: This is about, when I say hospital, it's a place where old soldiers went to retire.
sentences.zh: 当我说是医院时，这是一个老兵们退休养老的地方。

sentences.en: That's where Napoleon ends up buried.
sentences.zh: 那是拿破仑最终被安葬的地方。

sentences.en: I have filmed there, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 我在那里拍过片，多米尼克。

sentences.en: Have you?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: I've never been to Les Invalides, Tom.
sentences.zh: 我从来没去过荣军院，汤姆。

sentences.en: I really should go and pay my respects to Napoleon.
sentences.zh: 我真的应该去向拿破仑致敬。

sentences.en: I have stood next to his tomb and been filmed pondering.
sentences.zh: 我曾站在他的墓旁，被拍下沉思的画面。

sentences.en: Were you?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Were you dreaming about invading Russia, leaving your troops behind as you'd left them behind after invading Egypt?
sentences.zh: 你当时是在梦想着入侵俄国，把你的军队抛在身后，就像入侵埃及后把他们抛在身后一样吗？

sentences.en: Cursing the British mastery of the sea.
sentences.zh: 咒骂英国对海洋的统治。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Cursing the nation of shopkeepers.
sentences.zh: 咒骂这个小店主国家。

sentences.en: But obviously, at this point, he's not there.
sentences.zh: 但显然，此时此刻，他不在那里。

sentences.en: That goes without saying.
sentences.zh: 这是不言而喻的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: The Invalides managed to sort of keep them away for the time being.
sentences.zh: 荣军院设法暂时把他们挡在了外面。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, that guy, the mayor, Flessel, is sort of playing what seems to be a very strange game.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，那个市长弗莱塞尔似乎在玩一场非常奇怪的游戏。

sentences.en: People are saying to him, where are the arms?
sentences.zh: 人们对他说，武器在哪里？

sentences.en: And he's sending them off to different parts of the city where it seems like there's obviously not going to be any weapons.
sentences.zh: 他把他们打发到城市的各个不同地方，而那些地方显然不可能有任何武器。

sentences.en: And people are starting to be suspicious and thinking, is he playing a double game?
sentences.zh: 人们开始起疑心，心想，他是在玩两面派吗？

sentences.en: Is he just trying to buy time by sending us some wild goose chases?
sentences.zh: 他是不是只是想通过让我们进行毫无结果的搜寻来拖延时间？

sentences.en: But all that day, the 13th, there is a sense of kind of increasing disorder.
sentences.zh: 但在那一整天，即13日，有一种混乱不断加剧的感觉。

sentences.en: And then dawn breaks the following day, Tuesday, the 14th.
sentences.zh: 接着第二天黎明破晓，那是星期二，14日。

sentences.en: And the bread price, not surprisingly, given the chaos, has now reached its all-time peak.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，鉴于目前的混乱局势，面包价格现在达到了历史最高点。

sentences.en: So it's now about 15 sous.
sentences.zh: 所以现在大约是15苏。

sentences.en: And women who are going out to the markets to get bread are incredibly angry and saying, you know, this is intolerable.
sentences.zh: 去市场上买面包的妇女们气愤填膺，说道，你知道的，这太令人无法忍受了。

sentences.en: We can't eat.
sentences.zh: 我们没饭吃。

sentences.en: We must take matters into our own hands.
sentences.zh: 我们必须自己采取行动。

sentences.en: So that morning, the crowds are bigger than ever.
sentences.zh: 所以那天早上，人群比以往任何时候都要庞大。

sentences.en: About 80,000 people return to the Invalides.
sentences.zh: 大约8万人回到了荣军院。

sentences.en: They break in.
sentences.zh: 他们闯了进去。

sentences.en: Scenes of tremendous chaos kind of stampede.
sentences.zh: 现场一片大混乱，犹如惊马践踏。

sentences.en: There's a crush.
sentences.zh: 发生了踩踏事件。

sentences.en: People have been crushed underfoot.
sentences.zh: 有人被踩在脚下。

sentences.en: They get muskets, about 5,000 muskets.
sentences.zh: 他们弄到了滑膛枪，大约5000支滑膛枪。

sentences.en: They take out about 20 cannons and they're passing them out among the crowd.
sentences.zh: 他们搬出了大约20门大炮，并在人群中分发它们。

sentences.en: But there is one thing they don't have.
sentences.zh: 但有一点他们没有。

sentences.en: They don't have any gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何火药。

sentences.en: They don't have anything to basically make the cannons work.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有任何能让大炮运作的东西。

sentences.en: And so, Dominic, is there anywhere in Paris that might have a ready supply of gunpowder?
sentences.zh: 所以，多米尼克，巴黎有没有什么地方可能备有充足的火药？

sentences.en: There is one place, Tom.
sentences.zh: 有一个地方，汤姆。

sentences.en: And that place is the Bastille, the great fortress in the centre of Paris.
sentences.zh: 那个地方就是巴士底狱，巴黎市中心的大要塞。

sentences.en: And now the crowd turn their attention to the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 现在，人群将注意力转向了巴士底狱。

sentences.en: And Tom, the excitement has reached such a pitch.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，这种兴奋情绪已经达到了顶点。

sentences.en: I wonder if we should take a break just for our own health and safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我们是否应该为了自身的健康和安全原因休息一下。

sentences.en: I think we should.
sentences.zh: 我想我们应该休息一下。

sentences.en: I can't cope with the stress otherwise.
sentences.zh: 否则我承受不了这种压力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We'll be back in a few minutes with the storming of the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 我们几分钟后回来，继续讲述攻占巴士底狱的故事。

sentences.en: That flight with 350 passengers.
sentences.zh: 那架载有350名乘客的航班。

sentences.zh: 伟大的博弈。

sentences.zh: 英国与俄国之间的战略争端。

sentences.en: We assess, Prime Minister, with high confidence it was Russian.
sentences.zh: 首相先生，我们以高度的自信评估那是俄国干的。

sentences.zh: 让俄国人承担责任就是第三次世界大战。

sentences.zh: 他们击落了一架载有350人的英国客机。

sentences.zh: 克里姆林宫的那个人在玩火，亚历克斯。

sentences.zh: 你得问问自己，你想不想玩。

sentences.zh: 你是首相。

sentences.zh: 你什么都没做！

sentences.zh: 我们需要了解政策背景。

sentences.zh: 今天，所有相关背景都将被构建为一个框架。

sentences.zh: 谁能完成这个任务？

sentences.zh: 汤姆·麦克达夫中士！

sentences.zh: 达菲！

sentences.zh: 一场无与伦比的广播剧之旅。

sentences.zh: 像达菲这样的人，是我们最宝贵的武器。

sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我们正在接近法国历史上、乃至全球历史上最著名的时刻之一。

sentences.en: So the Bastille, Tom, you will know, because you did a wonderful episode about the man in the iron mask, that the Bastille is not quite what we think it was.
sentences.zh: 那么巴士底狱嘛，汤姆，你肯定知道，因为你做过一期关于铁面人的精彩节目，巴士底狱其实和我们想象的不太一样。

sentences.en: So in our imagination, the Bastille is this towering Gothic castle.
sentences.zh: 在我们想象中，巴士底狱是一座高耸的哥特式城堡。

sentences.en: Well, that's how it's shown in the paintings, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 对，画里就是这么画的，对吧？

sentences.en: In the paintings, it's looming over the city.
sentences.zh: 在画里，它高耸在城市上空。

sentences.en: It's this terrible symbol of royal oppression, the embodiment of despotism and tyranny and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 它是皇权压迫的可怕象征，是专制、暴政等等的化身。

sentences.en: Well, it's Gothic, isn't it, as well?
sentences.zh: 而且它很哥特，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because this is the kind of the period of Gothic fiction.
sentences.zh: 因为这也是哥特小说盛行的时期。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's a transplantation of a sinister baronial pile in the Alps or something, right into the middle of Paris.
sentences.zh: 它就像是从阿尔卑斯山或其他地方搬来的一座阴森森的男爵城堡，直接塞到了巴黎市中心。

sentences.en: But that's not actually what it is.
sentences.zh: 但它实际上并不是那样的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's got a bit of a Tower of London quality to it, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它有点伦敦塔的特质。

sentences.en: But it's quite squat.
sentences.zh: 但它相当矮胖。

sentences.en: It has eight round towers and it has walls that are five feet thick.
sentences.zh: 它有八座圆塔，墙壁有五英尺厚。

sentences.en: But it had been built in the Hundred Years' War as a defence against the English, I'm proud to say.
sentences.zh: 但它是在百年战争期间建造的，用来防御英国人，我很自豪地说。

sentences.en: And Charles the Mad, Charles VI, had converted it into a prison.
sentences.zh: 而且疯子查理，即查理六世，把它改建成了一座监狱。

sentences.en: Well, we'll be looking at this in a series we're going to be doing on Henry V in a few weeks' time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，几周后我们将在制作的关于亨利五世的系列节目中探讨这一点。

sentences.en: The Hundred Years' War?
sentences.zh: 百年战争？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But it was Cardinal Richelieu in the 17th century who really said, let's use it as a prison for prisoners of state.
sentences.zh: 但在17世纪，正是黎塞留枢机主教真正提出，把它用作关押政治犯的监狱。

sentences.en: And the people who were sent there, as you described in your episode that you did on The Man in the Iron Mask, there's a thing called a lettre de cachet.
sentences.zh: 正如你在关于《铁面人》的那期节目中所描述的那样，被送到那里的人，有一种东西叫做密札（lettre de cachet）。

sentences.en: And this is a kind of sealed letter approved by the king in which your crime is often not really, nearly even named.
sentences.zh: 这是一种由国王批准的密封信件，上面通常甚至没有真正指明你的罪名。

sentences.en: But basically, if there's a lettre de cachet, you can be sentenced without any process, without any trial.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，只要有了密札，你就可以在没有任何诉讼、没有任何审判的情况下被判刑。

sentences.en: You can be basically thrown behind bars.
sentences.zh: 你基本上就可以被投入大牢。

sentences.en: So people are obviously up in arMs.
sentences.zh: 所以人们显然群情激愤。

sentences.en: They see this as a symbol of arbitrary government and despotism and absolutism and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是专制政府、暴政和绝对主义等等的象征。

sentences.en: But there are kind of three kinds, really, aren't there?
sentences.zh: 但实际上主要有三种人，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So there's people who are seen as engaged in conspiracy against the monarchy.
sentences.zh: 一种是被认为参与反对君主制阴谋的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Of whom, whoever he is, The Man in the Iron Mask, would be the exemplary example.
sentences.zh: 无论他是谁，铁面人就是其中典型的代表。

sentences.en: And there are writers whose works are seen to be seditious.
sentences.zh: 还有一些作家的作品被认为具有煽动性。

sentences.en: So the most famous of these writers is Voltaire,
sentences.zh: 这些作家中最著名的是伏尔泰，

sentences.en: the great kind of wit and philosophe who actually writes the story of The Man in the Iron Mask and kind of invents it as a symbol of royal tyranny.
sentences.zh: 这位伟大的智者和哲学家，他实际上写了关于铁面人的故事，并将其塑造成皇家暴政的象征。

sentences.en: And then there are people who are seen by their own families as trouble.
sentences.zh: 还有一类人是被自己的家人视为麻烦制造者。

sentences.en: And again, there is a famous archetype of this, a literary figure, who we've also done an episode on, and that is the Marquis de Sade.
sentences.zh: 同样，有一个著名的文学原型，我们也曾为他做过一期节目，那就是萨德侯爵。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So delinquents, aristocratic usually, whose own families basically petition the monarchy, please, can you have my son locked up?
sentences.zh: 所以这些通常是贵族出身的不守规矩者，他们的家人基本上向君主请愿，求求你们把我儿子关起来吧？

sentences.en: He's totally out of control.
sentences.zh: 他完全失控了。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what it is, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就是这么回事，不是吗？

sentences.en: And actually, it's quite a kind of mark of status, isn't it, if you're a writer or a rebel?
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你是一个作家或叛逆者，被送到巴士底狱其实是一种地位的象征，对吧？

sentences.en: To be sent to the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 被送到那里去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: To be sent there, because that's what Beaumarchais finds so humiliating when he's sent to Saint-Lazare, that he isn't sent to the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 因为博马舍被送到圣拉扎尔时感到极其屈辱，就是因为他没有被送到巴士底狱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And actually, conditions in the Bastille, when I read up on it, it reminded me of the prisons that Dickens describes, like the Marshalsea or something.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我查阅资料时，巴士底狱里的条件让我想起了狄更斯描述的监狱，比如马歇尔西监狱什么的。

sentences.en: So it's all a bit Dickensian.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都有点狄更斯式的。

sentences.en: Sharma compares it to an overgrown lodging house, with guests living in different rooms, according to their station.
sentences.zh: 夏尔马将其比作一栋庞大的寄宿公寓，客人们根据自己的身份住在不同的房间里。

sentences.en: If you're a member of the public, you can actually walk into the Bastille and go in and sort of, there are shops on the inside.
sentences.zh: 如果你是普通公众，你其实可以走进巴士底狱，里面甚至还有商店。

sentences.en: There's a garden.
sentences.zh: 还有一个花园。

sentences.en: The governor has a vegetable garden.
sentences.zh: 总督有一个菜园。

sentences.en: So you can have a stroll and stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以去散散步之类的。

sentences.en: And inside, further inside, there's the kind of warren of rooms where the inmates are kept.
sentences.zh: 在更里面，是一片迷宫般的房间，关押着囚犯。

sentences.en: And the conditions are actually not really that bad.
sentences.zh: 而且条件其实并没有那么糟。

sentences.en: And so the extraordinary thing is, you are better off inside the Bastille than the vast majority of French people who live outside it.
sentences.zh: 所以不可思议的是，待在巴士底狱里的生活，要比生活在它外面的绝大多数法国人过得更好。

sentences.en: Well, the Marquis de Sade lives quite well.
sentences.zh: 萨德侯爵的生活过得相当不错。

sentences.en: I mean, he's able to write his novel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他能够写他的小说。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You have alcohol.
sentences.zh: 你有酒喝。

sentences.en: He sends his wife out to get him cheese and all kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 他派妻子出去给他买奶酪和各种各样的东西。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He has 133 books when he's in there.
sentences.zh: 他在里面时拥有133本书。

sentences.en: And he has a desk and he has dressing gowns.
sentences.zh: 他有一张书桌和晨衣。

sentences.en: He has aftershave.
sentences.zh: 他有须后水。

sentences.en: He's allowed all these kind of treats.
sentences.zh: 他被允许享受所有这些类别的优待。

sentences.en: This is the norm.
sentences.zh: 这是常态。

sentences.en: There are card games.
sentences.zh: 有纸牌游戏。

sentences.en: There's a billiard table.
sentences.zh: 有台球桌。

sentences.en: There's a writer called Jean-François Montmartre.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫让-弗朗索瓦·蒙马特的作家。

sentences.en: He was asked, what was the food like in the Bastille?
sentences.zh: 有人问他，巴士底狱里的食物怎么样？

sentences.en: And he said, I always remember an excellent soup, a succulent side of beef, a thigh of boiled chicken oozing with grease, a little dish of fried marinated artichokes,
sentences.zh: 他说，我总是记得一碗绝佳的汤、一份多汁的牛排、一只油汪汪的水煮鸡大腿、一小碟炸腌洋蓟，

sentences.en: really some fine croissant prayers, a bottle of old burgundy, the very best mocha coffee.
sentences.zh: 还有一些美味可口的羊角面包，一瓶陈年勃艮第葡萄酒，以及最好的摩卡咖啡。

sentences.en: So it's more like a hotel than a prison.
sentences.zh: 所以它更像是一家酒店，而不是监狱。

sentences.en: And the demonology of it was invented by writers to criticize the regime.
sentences.zh: 关于它的妖魔化是由作家们为了批评政权而捏造出来的。

sentences.en: So Voltaire.
sentences.zh: 比如伏尔泰。

sentences.en: Yes, they're most famous as a guy actually called Linge, who was a barrister who was sent there.
sentences.zh: 是的，最著名的其实是一个叫兰格的人，他是一名被送到那里的出庭律师。

sentences.en: And we don't really know why in 1780.
sentences.zh: 我们并不太清楚为什么他在1780年被送进去。

sentences.en: And he published a book called Memoirs of the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 他出版了一本名为《巴士底狱回忆录》的书。

sentences.en: And this is your classic kind of Gothic nightmare, you know, clanking chains, the door crashing shut behind you.
sentences.zh: 这就是你所熟悉的经典哥特式噩梦，你知道的，哗啦作响的铁链，在你身后轰然关上的大门。

sentences.en: And he invented the idea really that the Bastille was this kind of living tomb, that everybody in it was the walking dead.
sentences.zh: 他实际上发明了这样一种观念：巴士底狱是一个活生生的坟墓，里面的每个人都是行尸走肉。

sentences.en: They would never be heard from again.
sentences.zh: 他们再也不会被外界听到任何消息。

sentences.en: Well, he must be drawing on the Voltaire, the idea of the man in the iron mask as well.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他肯定也借鉴了伏尔泰关于铁面人的想法。

sentences.en: Those ideas have quite deep roots.
sentences.zh: 这些想法有着相当深厚的根基。

sentences.en: They do, and they're actually so successful, those ideas, that the government themselves have decided that the Bastille has to go.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，这些想法非常成功，以至于政府自己也决定必须拆除巴士底狱。

sentences.en: Because even though it's fine, it's kind of bad publicity to have it.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管它状况良好，但拥有它会带来不好的舆论。

sentences.en: So by the 1780s, they have a plan to redevelop the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 所以在18世纪80年代，他们有一个重新规划巴士底狱的计划。

sentences.en: They're going to build a park instead with a column and fountains in the middle.
sentences.zh: 他们打算建一个公园，中间立一根柱子和喷泉。

sentences.en: And there'll be an inscription that says, ironically, Louis XVI, restorer of public freedom.
sentences.zh: 还会有一块讽刺性的铭文，上面写着：路易十六，公共自由的恢复者。

sentences.en: Of course, that park, that never happens.
sentences.zh: 当然，那个公园从未建成。

sentences.en: I mean, the shades of irony, the veil, the totemic episodes in the French Revolution are amazing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，法国大革命中充满讽刺意味的面纱和那些标志性事件真是太惊人了。

sentences.en: So the Bastille has featured in people's imagination in the days leading up to the 14th of July, partly because of the Marquis de Sade, actually.
sentences.zh: 因此，在7月14日之前的几天里，巴士底狱一直是人们想象中的焦点，部分原因其实是因为萨德侯爵。

sentences.en: So he's in the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 当时他正被关在巴士底狱里。

sentences.en: He's been following all the news from Versailles.
sentences.zh: 他一直在关注来自凡尔赛的所有消息。

sentences.en: He's really into it, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他对此非常热心，不是吗？

sentences.en: And he's been shouting political harangues from the window.
sentences.zh: 他一直在从窗户大声发表政治演说。

sentences.en: Yes, because he takes the thing that he pees into, kind of metal, a funnel.
sentences.zh: 是的，因为他拿了他用来小便的那个金属漏斗。

sentences.en: And he uses that to shout out revolutionary slogans.
sentences.zh: 他用那个来大声喊出革命口号。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he says, I'm in here with hundreds of inmates and the governor is planning to kill us all.
sentences.zh: 他说，我和几百名囚犯被关在这里，总督正计划把我们全杀了。

sentences.en: And this is a complete fantasy.
sentences.zh: 这完全是幻想。

sentences.en: So he gets bundled off to a lunatic asylum, a Charenton.
sentences.zh: 所以他被五花大绑地塞进了一家精神病院，也就是沙朗通。

sentences.en: A lunatic asylum.
sentences.zh: 一家精神病院。

sentences.en: He's got to go.
sentences.zh: 他非走不可。

sentences.en: He's a real pain.
sentences.zh: 他真是个大麻烦。

sentences.en: Now, actually, we've mentioned the governor.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，我们刚才提到了总督。

sentences.en: So the Marquis de Sade was kicked out nine days ago.
sentences.zh: 所以萨德侯爵在九天前就被赶出去了。

sentences.en: And the governor, in those nine days, has been getting increasingly worried, as you might expect.
sentences.zh: 不出所料，在这九天里，总督越来越焦虑。

sentences.en: His name is Bernard René de Lornais, and he is 49 years old.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫伯纳德·勒内·德·洛奈，今年49岁。

sentences.en: He was born in the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 他在巴士底狱出生。

sentences.en: His father had been the governor as well.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲也曾是这里的总督。

sentences.en: And basically, he's a very, very dutiful, humdrum, you know, uncontroversial civil servant, the guy who runs the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他是一个非常非常顺从、单调乏味、无可争议的公务员，也就是管理巴士底狱的那个人。

sentences.en: He's not a bad man.
sentences.zh: 他不是个坏人。

sentences.en: He's not a torturer.
sentences.zh: 他不是个酷刑施加者。

sentences.en: He's nothing like that.
sentences.zh: 他一点也不像那样。

sentences.en: He's just kind of a boring official.
sentences.zh: 他只是个无聊的官员。

sentences.en: He doesn't cackle evilly while fettering people in dripping dungeons.
sentences.zh: 他不会一边在滴水的地牢里给人们戴上脚镣，一边发出邪恶的狞笑。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也没有。

sentences.en: And he's been given this gunpowder to guard.
sentences.zh: 他被委派看守这些火药。

sentences.en: The gunpowder has been sent to him, 250 barrels of it.
sentences.zh: 火药已经运送到他这里，一共250桶。

sentences.en: And he's been told, you know, don't let anyone have it.
sentences.zh: 他得到的指示是，你知道的，不要让任何人拿走。

sentences.en: He has been sort of making vague preparations, like moving the cannons to the embrasures.
sentences.zh: 他一直在做一些模糊的准备工作，比如把大炮移到炮眼处。

sentences.en: He's told his men to gather some stones to throw at people if they try to get in, and bits of iron mongery and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他告诉手下收集一些石头，以便如果有人试图闯入时用来砸他们，还有一些铁器之类的东西。

sentences.en: When I say his men, he has 82 old soldiers, like pensioners, Avalide, as they're called.
sentences.zh: 我说的手下，他有82名老兵，就像退休人员一样，也就是所谓的伤残军人。

sentences.en: And they are just loafers.
sentences.zh: 他们只是一群游手好闲的人。

sentences.en: They're completely useless.
sentences.zh: 他们完全没用。

sentences.en: They're not going to be at all used in a fight.
sentences.zh: 他们在战斗中根本派不上用场。

sentences.en: And he's also been sent 32 Swiss guards.
sentences.zh: 而且还派了32名瑞士卫兵给他。

sentences.en: He has enough food to last him two days, and he has no water supply whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 他手头的食物只够维持两天，而且他没有任何形式的水源。

sentences.en: So when he sees this giant crowd advancing towards him, he thinks, oh, for God's sake, this is the last thing I need.
sentences.zh: 所以当他看到这群庞大的人群向他推进时，他想，天哪，这正是我最不需要的事情。

sentences.en: Now, this crowd later ends up being sort of, dare I say, sacralized, Tom.
sentences.zh: 现在，这群人后来最终被，我敢说，神圣化了，汤姆。

sentences.en: There are 954 of them, and they are aged between 1872, and they're known officially as the vainqueurs.
sentences.zh: 他们一共有954人，年龄在18到72岁之间，官方称他们为“攻占者”。

sentences.en: So most of these vainqueurs are artisans from the Saint-Antoine neighborhood, the neighborhood around the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 所以这些攻占者大多是圣安托万街区的手工业者，也就是巴士底狱周边的街区。

sentences.en: And they are joiners and glaziers and cabinet makers and locksmiths.
sentences.zh: 他们是细木工、玻璃匠、家具匠和锁匠。

sentences.en: So because they ended up as these great heroes of the revolution, we know loads about them.
sentences.zh: 因为他们最终成为了革命的伟大英雄，我们对他们的情况了解甚多。

sentences.en: Only one of them is a woman, a laundress, a mariage charpentier.
sentences.zh: 其中只有一名女性，是一名女洗衣工，名叫玛丽·夏尔庞捷。

sentences.en: Most of them, historians have really done tremendous work kind of analyzing their background.
sentences.zh: 历史学家们对他们进行了绝佳的工作，分析了他们绝大多数人的背景。

sentences.en: Most of them had not been born in Paris.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数都不是在巴黎出生的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So that gives you a sense of just how transient the Parisian population is.
sentences.zh: 这让你对巴黎人口的流动性有了深刻的体会。

sentences.en: How many migrants have come from the countryside for work or for bread and are now angry and resentful?
sentences.zh: 有多少从乡村来寻找工作或面包的移民，现在正感到愤怒和怨恨？

sentences.en: Because in a city like Paris, people are going to die of disease.
sentences.zh: 因为在像巴黎这样的城市里，人们会死于疾病。

sentences.en: And so the population cannot be maintained without this constant influx of people.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果没有源源不断的人口流入，人口规模就无法维持。

sentences.en: Constant flow.
sentences.zh: 源源不断的流动。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没，错。

sentences.en: So they are angry, resentful, hungry.
sentences.zh: 所以他们愤怒、怨恨、饥饿。

sentences.en: They're also frightened.
sentences.zh: 他们也很害怕。

sentences.en: There are lots of rumors that the army are preparing to retake the city.
sentences.zh: 有许多传言说军队正准备重新夺回这座城市。

sentences.en: They're desperate to get this gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 他们极其渴望得到这些火药。

sentences.en: So they've assembled, a thousand of them or so, shouting and roaring outside the walls of the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 于是他们聚集起来，大约有一千人，在巴士底狱的墙外大声呐喊咆哮。

sentences.en: More happily for Delaunay, two delegates arrive from the city hall, from the Hôtel de Ville.
sentences.zh: 对洛奈来说更幸运的是，两名来自市政厅的代表抵达了。

sentences.en: And they say, look, we've come to see you.
sentences.zh: 他们说，听着，我们是来见你的。

sentences.en: And he says, well, funnily enough, I'm about to have dinner.
sentences.zh: 而他说，嗯，说来也巧，我正准备吃晚饭。

sentences.en: It's 10 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 现在是十点钟。

sentences.en: So it's described as his déjeuner, but it's more of a brunch.
sentences.zh: 所以这被描述为他的午餐，但其实更像是一顿早午餐。

sentences.en: He's about to have brunch.
sentences.zh: 他正准备吃早午餐。

sentences.en: Petit déjeuner.
sentences.zh: 早点。

sentences.en: And he says, why don't you come in?
sentences.zh: 然后他说，你们为什么不进来呢？

sentences.en: And so these guys go in and they have this enormous, I mean, obviously it's France, right?
sentences.zh: 于是这些人进去了，他们享用了丰盛的——我的意思是，显然这是法国，对吧？

sentences.en: They have this enormous meal, which goes on for hours.
sentences.zh: 他们享用了一顿持续了几个小时的丰盛大餐。

sentences.en: And the crowd become very restless.
sentences.zh: 而人群变得非常躁动不安。

sentences.en: Well, if they're all starving to death outside.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果他们都在外面快要饿死的话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they're all having their croissant.
sentences.zh: 而他们却都在吃着牛角面包。

sentences.en: And of course, we know what they're eating in the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们知道他们在巴士底狱里吃的是什么。

sentences.en: They're having an excellent soup, a suck in a side of beef, a thigh of boiled chicken, oozing with grease.
sentences.zh: 他们吃着极好的汤、一块牛肉、一块煮鸡大腿，还滋滋地冒着油脂。

sentences.en: They're having all this.
sentences.zh: 他们正在享用这一切。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: The crowd get very restless.
sentences.zh: 人群变得非常躁动不安。

sentences.en: Another deputy arrives called Thuriot de la Rosière and he goes in to see Dornay.
sentences.zh: 另一位名叫蒂里奥·德·拉·罗齐尔的代表抵达了，他进去见多尔奈。

sentences.en: And by this time, he's got a very firm list of demands.
sentences.zh: 而此时，他已经有了一份非常坚定的诉求清单。

sentences.en: He says, we want all your guns as cannons, as well as the gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们要你们所有的火枪和大炮，还有火药。

sentences.en: And you must allow our new militia, the bourgeois guard, to take over the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 并且你们必须允许我们的新民兵，也就是市民卫队，接管巴士底狱。

sentences.en: And Dornay says, look, I can't do that.
sentences.zh: 而多尔奈说，听着，我不能这么做。

sentences.en: I need instructions from Versailles.
sentences.zh: 我需要来自凡尔赛的指示。

sentences.en: I've got my orders.
sentences.zh: 我有我的命令。

sentences.en: I'm just doing my job.
sentences.zh: 我只是在履行职责。

sentences.en: I don't want any trouble, but you can't ask me stuff that I can't deliver.
sentences.zh: 我不想惹麻烦，但你们不能要求我做我办不到的事。

sentences.en: However, Thuriot says, you know, I understand where you're coming from.
sentences.zh: 然而，蒂里奥说，你知道的，我理解你的立场。

sentences.en: I'm not happy about it, but I will go back to the Hôtel de Ville and report back and find out what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我对此很不高兴，但我会回市政厅去汇报，并弄清楚接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: So Thuriot goes back to the Hôtel de Ville and there all these sort of electors and officials are huddled together and they're chatting for about an hour about what are we going to
sentences.zh: 于是蒂里奥回到了市政厅，那里所有的选举人和官员都挤在一起，他们聊了一个多小时，讨论我们该

sentences.en: do about the Bastille?
sentences.zh: 如何处理巴士底狱？

sentences.en: And actually their attitude is we don't want to fray in the centre of Paris.
sentences.zh: 事实上他们的态度是，我们不想在巴黎市中心引发骚乱。

sentences.en: And Dominic, just to be clear, at this point, their concern is with the Bastille as a source of ammunition rather than its role as an emblem of royal tyranny.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，为了明确起见，此时他们的关注点在于巴士底狱作为弹药来源的角色，而不是它作为皇权暴政象征的角色。

sentences.en: Yes, that is what they want.
sentences.zh: 是的，这正是他们想要的。

sentences.en: They want the gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 他们想要火药。

sentences.en: They want the guns.
sentences.zh: 他们想要枪支。

sentences.en: But they're not talking about, you know, the Bastille as the Gothic castle and stuff.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有在谈论，你知道的，把巴士底狱当成哥特式城堡之类的事。

sentences.en: I mean, they can see the Bastille and they know what it is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们能看到巴士底狱，也知道它是什么。

sentences.en: But they've been talking for about an hour.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经讨论了一个多小时。
现在是一点半。

sentences.en: Thuriot is going to be sent back to the Bastille with a loud hailer to kind of address the crowd and stuff.
sentences.zh: 蒂里奥将被派回巴士底狱，拿着扩音器向人群发表讲话之类的事情。

sentences.en: When suddenly they hear there's this enormous explosion and the Hotel de Ville literally
sentences.zh: 突然，他们听到了一声巨大的爆炸声，市政厅简直

sentences.en: shakes and then they hear this further explosions, gunfire, and it's all coming from the direction of the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 在震动，接着他们听到了更多的爆炸声、枪声，而这一切都来自巴士底狱的方向。

sentences.en: What has happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, while Thuriot and his friends have been meeting in the city hall, the crowd outside the Bastille have run out of patience and have just decided to take matters into their own
sentences.zh: 嗯，正当蒂里奥和他的朋友们在市政厅开会时，巴士底狱外的人群已经失去了耐心，决定亲自采取行动

sentences.en: hands.
sentences.zh: 了。

sentences.en: And some of them have started to burst into that outer courtyard with the vegetable garden and the shops, shouting, give us the Bastille, give us the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人开始闯入那个带有菜园和商店的外庭院，大喊着，把巴士底狱交出来，把巴士底狱交出来。

sentences.en: A load of them climb up to the top of a perfume shop, which is next to the gate that goes into the inner courtyard.
sentences.zh: 许多人爬上了一家香水店的顶部，该店紧邻通往内庭院的大门。

sentences.en: And there's a drawbridge, which is closed.
sentences.zh: 那里有一座吊桥，此时是关着的。

sentences.en: They cut the ropes holding the drawbridge up.
sentences.zh: 他们砍断了支撑吊桥的绳子。

sentences.en: Now, this is that classic kind of mad crowd behavior.
sentences.zh: 现在，这就是那种典型的疯狂人群行为。

sentences.en: The drawbridge at this point falls open very unexpectedly and it crushes people underneath.
sentences.zh: 此时吊桥非常意外地轰然落下，把下面的人压在底下。

sentences.en: One person has died.
sentences.zh: 一个人丧生了。

sentences.en: The rest of the crowd, they go damn about that and they just run over the drawbridge, presumably further flattening this poor man.
sentences.zh: 人群中的其他人对此感到懊恼，于是直接从吊桥上跑过去，想必把这个可怜的人压得更扁了。

sentences.en: There are soldiers up at the top who are shouting, stay away, stay away.
sentences.zh: 上面有士兵在大喊，待在那别动，待在那别动。

sentences.en: We don't want to shoot you.
sentences.zh: 我们不想向你们开枪。

sentences.en: The crowd think they are saying, come in, come in.
sentences.zh: 人群以为他们在喊，进来，进来。

sentences.en: We won't shoot.
sentences.zh: 我们不会开枪。

sentences.en: So they charge in and the Swiss guards start shooting at them.
sentences.zh: 于是他们冲了进去，瑞士卫队开始向他们开枪。

sentences.en: Now the crowd believe quite wrongly.
sentences.zh: 现在人群深信不疑，尽管完全弄错了。

sentences.en: The people further behind say, oh, they must have lowered the drawbridge and let us into the inner courtyard as a trick because they wanted to shoot us down like dogs.
sentences.zh: 更后面的人说，哦，他们肯定是放下吊桥，把我们放进内庭院，这是一个诡计，因为他们想把我们像狗一样射杀。

sentences.en: And they go ballistic.
sentences.zh: 他们彻底疯了。

sentences.en: The crowd is now stampeding further into the Bastille and the fighting kind of breaks out in earneSt.
sentences.zh: 人群现在正进一步向巴士底狱狂奔，战斗真正爆发了。

sentences.en: And what then happens, of course, rumors spread, you know, Chinese whispers.
sentences.zh: 然后发生了什么，当然，谣言四起，也就是以讹传讹。

sentences.en: People are sort of saying, it's all kicking off at the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 人们纷纷议论说，巴士底狱那边全乱套了。

sentences.en: The guards are shooting at our people, at the crowd.
sentences.zh: 卫兵在向我们的人民、向人群开枪。

sentences.en: There's a guy who's called Hulin, Pierre-Augustin Hulin.
sentences.zh: 有一个人叫于兰，皮埃尔-奥古斯丁·于兰。

sentences.en: And he runs out and he gets a load of guards françaises, French guards.
sentences.zh: 他跑出去，找了一大帮法国卫兵。

sentences.en: And he says, the criminal Delaunay is assassinating our fathers, our wives and our children.
sentences.zh: 他说，罪犯洛奈正在谋杀我们的父老乡亲、妻子和孩子。

sentences.en: Will you let them be slaughtered?
sentences.zh: 难道你们要任由他们被屠杀吗？

sentences.en: So these guards françaises arrive and they've brought with them some cannons.
sentences.zh: 于是这些法国卫兵赶到了，他们随身带来了一些大炮。

sentences.en: And one of those, Tom, is that Siamese cannon.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，其中一门就是那尊暹罗大炮。

sentences.en: Oh, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: With the elephants.
sentences.zh: 带着大象的那门。

sentences.en: Well, the elephants, I think, are a figment of your imagination.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大象，我认为那是你想象出来的产物。

sentences.en: But let's imagine it with the elephants, which was a present for Louis XIV.
sentences.zh: 但让我们想象一下带有大象的它，那是送给路易十四的礼物。

sentences.en: And they aim these cannon at the gates.
sentences.zh: 他们把这些大炮对准了大门。

sentences.en: So it's total chaos inside the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 所以巴士底狱里面一片混乱。

sentences.en: Delaunay, the governor, is obviously very distressed at what's happening.
sentences.zh: 总督洛奈显然对发生的事情感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's enjoyed a nice breakfaSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，他刚刚享用了一顿美妙的早餐。

sentences.en: And now...
sentences.zh: 现在……

sentences.en: Yeah, he did get his brunch.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实吃到了他的早午餐。

sentences.en: I mean, Tom, that's fair to say the last brunch he'll ever have, sadly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，汤姆，可以说这是他吃过的最后一顿早午餐了，真令人遗憾。

sentences.en: He just wants basically the whole thing to be over with honor.
sentences.zh: 他基本上只想体面地结束这一切。

sentences.en: And he wants an honorable surrender and no more bloodshed.
sentences.zh: 他想要有尊严地投降，不再有流血事件。

sentences.en: He sends a note to the leaders of the crowd and he says, look, I've got all these barrels of gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 他给人群的领袖们送去一张纸条，上面写着，听着，我这里有这么多的火药桶。

sentences.en: If you don't stop attacking, I will blow up the gunpowder and the...
sentences.zh: 如果你们不停止进攻，我就引爆火药和……

sentences.en: I'll blow up the whole thing, sky high.
sentences.zh: 我要把整栋建筑炸上天。

sentences.en: They don't want to give in to this ultimatum.
sentences.zh: 他们不想向这个最后通牒屈服。

sentences.en: And in fact, his own soldiers say, we don't want you to blow up all the gunpowder and us with it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他自己的士兵也说，我们可不想让你炸毁所有的火药，把我们一块儿炸飞。

sentences.en: And so eventually, Delaunay, this wheeze of his has failed.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，洛奈的这个妙计失败了。

sentences.en: And he says, fine, call it a day.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，今天就到这里吧。

sentences.en: And he lowers the drawbridge that leads to the inner courtyards.
sentences.zh: 他放下了通往内庭院的吊桥。

sentences.en: The attackers now swarm over this drawbridge.
sentences.zh: 进攻者现在蜂拥过这座吊桥。

sentences.en: I mean, even though he's basically surrendered and let them in, they're determined to have their sort of moment of glory anyway.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，尽管他基本上已经投降并放他们进来了，但他们仍然决心要获得他们的高光时刻。

sentences.en: So they climb the walls and they hack down the gate, which is a bit kind of unnecessary.
sentences.zh: 所以他们爬上墙壁，砍倒了大门，这其实有点多此一举。

sentences.en: And by about five o'clock in the afternoon, the siege is over and there are white flags flying above the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 大约在下午五点左右，围攻结束了，巴士底狱上空飘扬着白旗。

sentences.en: And they think they are going to find victims of royal despotism chained up in dungeons, do they?
sentences.zh: 他们以为会在地牢里找到被铁链锁住的皇权专制受害者，是吗？

sentences.en: Of course they do.
sentences.zh: 他们当然这么认为了。

sentences.en: I mean, don't forget the Marquis de Sade has been telling them that this massacre was impending.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，别忘了萨德侯爵一直在告诉他们这场大屠杀即将来临。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And for years, as you said, going back to Voltaire, people have believed that the Bastille is rammed with the victims of despotism.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，多年来，从伏尔泰开始，人们一直认为巴士底狱里挤满了专制的受害者。

sentences.en: So how many did they find?
sentences.zh: 那么他们找到了多少人？

sentences.en: There are seven people in the Bastille, Tom.
sentences.zh: 巴士底狱里有七个人，汤姆。

sentences.en: Seven prisoners.
sentences.zh: 七名囚犯。

sentences.en: Four of whom are genuine criminals who are forgers, who cannot be romanticized at all.
sentences.zh: 其中四人是真正的罪犯，也就是伪造犯，他们身上完全没有什么浪漫色彩可言。

sentences.en: But they go free, do they?
sentences.zh: 但他们被释放了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, the forgers do go free, I think.
sentences.zh: 是的，伪造犯确实被释放了，我想是的。

sentences.en: One of them is sort of one of your posh libertines, a guy called the Comte de Solage, who'd been locked up at the request of his own family for bad behavior.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是那种时髦的浪荡公子，一个叫索拉日伯爵的人，他因为行为不端应家里的要求而被关押起来。

sentences.en: And two are lunatics.
sentences.zh: 还有两个是疯子。

sentences.en: So of the lunatics, as they're called, one of them is just obviously completely mad.
sentences.zh: 所以在被称为疯子的这两人中，其中一个显然完全疯了。

sentences.en: And the other one is probably, some sources say English, some Irish, but I think it's generally agreed he's Irish.
sentences.zh: 而另一个人可能——有些消息来源说是英国人，有些说是爱尔兰人，但我认为普遍认为他是爱尔兰人。

sentences.en: He has a long white beard, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他留着长长的白胡子，对吧？

sentences.en: Which is good visuals.
sentences.zh: 视觉效果很不错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People call him major white.
sentences.zh: 人们叫他怀特少校。

sentences.en: He looks good.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很不错。

sentences.en: All candidates that they have that they can say they've rescued from this massacre, a symbol of liberation, because he's got this beard.
sentences.zh: 他们把所有候选人都当作可以宣称从这场大屠杀中拯救出来的象征自由的人物，因为他留着胡子。

sentences.en: And he thinks he's Julius Caesar, doesn't he?
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己是尤利乌斯·恺撒，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, they put him on their shoulders and carry him around the city.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们把他架在肩膀上在城里到处游行。

sentences.en: Hurrah, look at this man.
sentences.zh: 万岁，看看这个人。

sentences.en: Now he thinks he's Julius Caesar.
sentences.zh: 现在他觉得自己是尤利乌斯·恺撒了。

sentences.en: So he's very confused by the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 所以他对整件事感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: And he's kind of waving at the crowds.
sentences.zh: 他一直在向人群挥手。

sentences.en: And I think the next day, they take him and lock him up in a lunatic asylum again.
sentences.zh: 我想第二天，他们就把他抓起来又关进了精神病院。

sentences.en: So actually, he was probably better off in the Bastille with his fine foods and his billiard table.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，他待在有美食和台球桌的巴士底狱里可能还过得好一些。

sentences.en: Anyway, just on the Bastille itself, this is obviously very disappointing from the revolution's point of view.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，就巴士底狱本身而言，从革命的角度来看，这显然非常令人失望。

sentences.en: So they have to completely reinvent what happened and what they found.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们不得不彻底重塑发生的事情以及他们所发现的东西。

sentences.en: Revolutionary artists pour out prints and engravings that show torture chambers,
sentences.zh: 革命艺术家们大量印刷版画和雕刻作品，展示着酷刑室、

sentences.en: you know, iron maidens, men in iron masks, all of that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，铁娘子、铁面人，所有诸如此类的内容。

sentences.en: And also the battlements being much, much larger than they really were.
sentences.zh: 还有那些城垛，比实际情况要宏大得多。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: This extraordinary sort of Helm's Deep style siege.
sentences.zh: 这种非同寻常的类似于《指环王》圣盔谷风格的围攻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Which is not really what it was.
sentences.zh: 这其实并不是当时真实的情况。

sentences.en: Uh, they find some bits of old armor in the sort of cellar and they bring that out and they say, torture equipment.
sentences.zh: 呃，他们在某种地窖里找到了一些旧盔甲的碎片，然后拿出来说，这是酷刑器具。

sentences.en: They find a printing press, torture machine, all this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了一台印刷机，说这是酷刑机器，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Bastille tourism in the next few days becomes a huge thing.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，巴士底狱旅游业成了一件大事。

sentences.en: So they basically, former warders turn up and they're giving you a guided tour of the cells.
sentences.zh: 基本上，前看守们会出现，为你提供牢房的导游服务。

sentences.en: Posh women will have themselves locked in overnight.
sentences.zh: 时髦的贵妇们会让自己被锁在里面过夜。

sentences.en: A really interesting story, and you can read up more about this in a lot of the French Revolution histories.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的故事，你可以在许多法国大革命的历史书中读到更多相关内容。

sentences.en: Simon Sharma's really good on this, for example.
sentences.zh: 西蒙·沙玛在这方面的著作写得非常棒。

sentences.en: There was a guy in the crowd who was a building contractor called Pierre-Francois Palloy, and he's very entrepreneurial.
sentences.zh: 人群中有一个人是一名建筑承包商，名叫皮埃尔-弗朗索瓦·帕卢瓦，他非常有商业头脑。

sentences.en: He basically gets the contract to demolish the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 他基本上拿到了拆除巴士底狱的合同。

sentences.en: He makes tons of money from organizing guided tours, lectures, all this kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 他通过组织导游、讲座和各种类似活动赚了数不清的钱。

sentences.en: He builds France's first revolutionary altar from chains and manacles that he claimed to have found in the Bastille.
sentences.zh: 他用据称在巴士底狱找到的铁链和手铐，建造了法国第一个革命祭坛。

sentences.en: And then he becomes the great entrepreneur of Bastille merchandising.
sentences.zh: 然后他成了巴士底狱纪念品大亨。

sentences.en: So he puts together a traveling revolution kit that his reps, his sales reps, take to every part of France, every one of the 83 new departments.
sentences.zh: 于是他拼凑出一个流动的革命工具包，由他的代理人、销售代表带到法国各地，也就是全部 83 个新设省。

sentences.en: And it includes a big chest of souvenirs, literally inkwells that are supposedly made from fetters, paperweights in the shape of the Bastille, daggers, snuff boxes.
sentences.zh: 里面有一个装满纪念品的木箱，字面意思上用镣铐做成的墨水瓶、巴士底狱形状的镇纸、匕首和鼻烟壶。

sentences.en: So Dominic, it's very like the way the Berlin Wall, you know, the chunks of the Berlin Wall were sold when it came down.
sentences.zh: 所以多米尼克，这非常像柏林墙倒塌时，柏林墙碎片被售卖的那种方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, enough chunks of the Berlin Wall to make millions of Berlin Walls, I think it's fair to say.
sentences.zh: 对，柏林墙的碎片多到足以拼出数百万堵柏林墙，我觉得这么说并不过分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 完全一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a cross between medieval relics and basically modern souvenir tat,
sentences.zh: 对，这是中世纪圣物与现代垃圾纪念品之间的结合体，

sentences.en: Mr. Palloy's souvenir kits.
sentences.zh: 帕卢瓦先生的纪念品工具包。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's the jump ahead.
sentences.zh: 总之，这是后话。

sentences.en: Let's go back to the afternoon of the 14th of July.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到 7 月 14 日的下午。

sentences.en: So what happened to all the defenders?
sentences.zh: 那么所有的守卫怎么了？

sentences.en: The Swiss guards were initially unharmed because they'd taken the uniforms off so nobody knew who they were.
sentences.zh: 瑞士卫兵最初安然无恙，因为他们脱下了制服，所以没人知道他们是谁。

sentences.en: Some of the Avalides are very, very harshly treated.
sentences.zh: 一些荣军院老兵受到了非常、非常严厉的对待。

sentences.en: A good example of this, there's a guy called Beccar.
sentences.zh: 一个很好的例子是，有个叫贝卡尔的家伙。

sentences.en: And this I think is a quite scary warning of what lies ahead.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是对未来局势一个相当可怕的警告。

sentences.en: Beccar had been one of the key people in dissuading Delaunay from blowing up the gunpowder.
sentences.zh: 贝卡尔曾是劝阻德洛内引爆火药的关键人物之一。

sentences.en: So actually, the crowd should have been quite grateful to him.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，人群本该对他相当感激。

sentences.en: But as soon as they get inside, he opens one of the gates and somebody cuts off his hand.
sentences.zh: 但他们一冲进去，他就打开了一扇大门，然后有人砍下了他的手。

sentences.en: The crowd believe that he must have been a jailer.
sentences.zh: 人群认为他一定是个狱卒。

sentences.en: So they wave his hand around.
sentences.zh: 于是他们挥舞着他的手。

sentences.en: And it's presumably still got the keys hanging from the...
sentences.zh: 而且上面大概还挂着钥匙……

sentences.en: It's got the key in, yeah.
sentences.zh: 上面挂着钥匙，对。

sentences.en: Sorry, it's got the key because he's opened the gate.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，上面有钥匙，因为他打开了门。

sentences.en: So because of this, they parade around the city carrying this poor bloke's hand.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们举着这个可怜家伙的手在城里游行。

sentences.en: Anyway, he manages to live to the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，他勉强活到了那天结束。

sentences.en: But then somebody again misidentifies him and says, I think that bloke was one of the guys who was firing the cannons at the people, which he wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但随后又有人认错了他，说，我觉得那家伙是向民众开炮的人之一，其实他并没有。

sentences.en: And so he ends up being hanged along with some of his comrades, which is very unfortunate, but not as chilling as something that has always stayed in my mind
sentences.zh: 结果他和一些战友一起被绞死了，这非常不幸，但还不如一件事那样让我毛骨悚然，这件事一直留在我脑海中

sentences.en: ever since I first read it, which must be 30, 40 years ago, which is what happened to Governor Delaunay.
sentences.zh: 自从我第一次读到它以来，那一定得是 30、40 年前了，那就是总督德洛内的遭遇。

sentences.en: Remember I said, he's just a functionary.
sentences.zh: 还记得我说过吗，他只是个职能官员。

sentences.en: He wanted to kill himself.
sentences.zh: 他本来想自杀。

sentences.en: He was so shamed by the dishonor of surrendering the fortress, but he was stopped from doing so by a grenadier.
sentences.zh: 他因交出要塞的耻辱而感到羞愧难当，但被一名掷弹兵阻止了。

sentences.en: And the crowd sees on him and they drag him out and they drag him towards the Hotel de Ville.
sentences.zh: 人群扑向他，把他拖出来，拖向市政厅。

sentences.en: He's being dragged through the streets.
sentences.zh: 他被拖过街道。

sentences.en: People are spitting on him and kicking him and on all sorts.
sentences.zh: 人们向他吐口水、踢他，各种折磨都有。

sentences.en: A horrible scene.
sentences.zh: 可怕的场景。

sentences.en: They get to the Hotel de Ville and then they say, let's kill him in a really amusing, baroque way.
sentences.zh: 他们到了市政厅，然后说，让我们用一种非常有趣、极其夸张的方式杀死他。

sentences.en: And there are some people who say, why don't we tie him to a horse's tail and drag him through the city and he will die by being dragged over the cobbles.
sentences.zh: 有些人说，为什么不把他绑在马尾巴上，拖着他穿过城市，他就会被卵石路面拖死。

sentences.en: Because that's the kind of thing that royal executions do to awe and intimidate the masses.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是皇家处决用来震慑和吓唬大众的手段。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so I suppose there's a kind of element of paying royal officials in their own kind.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这某种程度上也算是一种以其人之道还治其人之身。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's a pastry cook,
sentences.zh: 有个糕点师，

sentences.en: Deneau, who says, no, we'll take him into the city hall, the Hotel de Ville, and we will give him a kind of a trial or something.
sentences.zh: 德诺，他说，不，我们把他带进市政厅，我们要给他进行某种审判之类的。

sentences.en: And Delaunay, who at this point is battered, bruised, covered with blood, you know, crying, whatever, he says, enough of this, let me die.
sentences.zh: 而此时此刻的德洛内，饱受殴打、浑身是伤、血迹斑斑、痛哭流涕，诸如此类，他说，够了，让我死吧。

sentences.en: And he lashes out furiously and kicks the pastry cook,
sentences.zh: 他狂怒地猛冲过去，踢了糕点师

sentences.en: Deneau, in the groin.
sentences.zh: 德诺的腹股沟。

sentences.en: And at that point, the crowd kind of close in on him, daggers drawn, bayonets, people are in a frenzy and they stab and stab and stab and kill him.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，人群朝他围了上来，匕首出鞘、刺刀闪闪，人们陷入疯狂，他们不停地刺、刺、刺，杀了他。

sentences.en: Poor Delaunay.
sentences.zh: 可怜的德洛内。

sentences.en: And then people shoot his body as it lies in the gutter.
sentences.zh: 然后人们向躺在阴沟里的尸体开枪。

sentences.en: And then somebody gives Deneau the pastry cook sword and says, you have the honour of cutting off his head.
sentences.zh: 接着有人把糕点师德诺的剑交给他，并说，你有幸砍下他的头。

sentences.en: And Deneau throws the sword aside.
sentences.zh: 德诺把剑扔到一边。

sentences.en: I don't need the sword, he says.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不需要剑。

sentences.en: And he gets out a pocket knife and he then kneels down and basically saws this governor's head off.
sentences.zh: 他掏出一把小折刀，然后跪下来，开始锯这位总督的头。

sentences.en: And so this story began with wax heads being paraded and now...
sentences.zh: 所以这个故事从游行示威的蜡头开始，现在……

sentences.en: Yeah, and now real heads.
sentences.zh: 对，现在是真的人头。

sentences.en: And they put his head on a pike.
sentences.zh: 他们把他的头插在长矛上。

sentences.en: There are women in the crowd kind of, this is what shocks some witnesses, kind of cheering and singing and they parade around.
sentences.zh: 人群中的女性开始——这也是让一些目击者震惊的地方——欢呼唱歌，到处游行。

sentences.en: The mayor is it's been in the
sentences.zh: 市长，他一直都在

sentences.en: Hôtel de Ville all this time,
sentences.zh: 市政厅里，

sentences.en: Jacques de Flessel.
sentences.zh: 雅克·德·弗莱塞勒。

sentences.en: This is the double-crossing mayor.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个两面三刀的市长。

sentences.en: The people suspect to double-crossing them.
sentences.zh: 人们怀疑他背叛了他们。

sentences.en: They seize him as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也抓了他。

sentences.en: They say afterwards they found a letter from Delaunay in his pocket saying, you know, hold out, let's distract the rabble.
sentences.zh: 他们事后说在他的口袋里找到了一封德洛内的信，上面写着，你知道的，坚持住，让我们分散暴民的注意力。

sentences.en: Whether this is true, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 这是否属实，我们不得而知。

sentences.en: Of course, there's no evidence for it now.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在没有任何证据。

sentences.en: Flessel too was taken outside.
sentences.zh: 弗莱塞勒也被带到了外面。

sentences.en: He was basically ripped to pieces by the crowd, shot in the head, his head cut off, put on a pike.
sentences.zh: 他基本上被人群碎尸万段，头部中枪，头被砍下，插在长矛上。

sentences.en: And then the crowd paraded through the streets with his two heads on pikes.
sentences.zh: 然后人群举着他的两颗人头在街上游行。

sentences.en: So this is what's been happening in the city.
sentences.zh: 这就是城里发生的事情。

sentences.en: That evening, it starts to rain.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，开始下雨了。

sentences.en: And anyone who knows anything about riots and mobs knows that basically the single best way to end a riot is for it to start raining.
sentences.zh: 任何了解暴乱和暴民的人都知道，平息暴乱最好的绝招其实就是开始下雨。

sentences.en: So like the Chartists in 1848 got rained on and there was no revolution.
sentences.zh: 就像 1848 年宪章派淋了雨，于是革命就没有发生。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So everything has died down in Paris, but the National Assembly, of course, is still in Versailles.
sentences.zh: 所以巴黎的一切都平息了，但国民议会当然还在凡尔赛。

sentences.en: That evening, as the rain is falling, a guy called the Vicomte de Noailles bursts into the National Assembly in Versailles, which is hours away ride or whatever, and says,
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚，随着雨水落下，一个叫诺阿耶子爵的人冲进了凡尔赛的国民议会——骑马需要几个小时的路程，或者诸如此类——并说，

sentences.en: all this chaos has kicked off in the city.
sentences.zh: 城里爆发了这般混乱。

sentences.en: And actually, the National Assembly are not jubilant.
sentences.zh: 事实上，国民议会并没有欢欣鼓舞。

sentences.en: They are anxious and shocked.
sentences.zh: 他们感到焦虑和震惊。

sentences.en: It is clear to them, to some of them, even now, that this process that they thought they were controlling until a few days ago is spiraling well beyond their ability
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人甚至现在就已经清楚，他们几天前还以为自己能掌控的进程，已经远远超出了他们

sentences.en: to restrain it.
sentences.zh: 能够控制的能力范围。

sentences.en: The king himself has been in the palace all day.
sentences.zh: 国王自己整天都在宫殿里。

sentences.en: That is why, in his journal, he writes the word rien, nothing, because it's a hunting journal and he has not done any hunting, which in itself is a sign of how, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在他的日记里，他写下了“rien”这个词，意思是“无”，因为这是一本狩猎日记，而他没有进行任何狩猎，这本身就说明了

sentences.en: things have changed for him.
sentences.zh: 他的处境发生了多大的变化。

sentences.en: Yeah, so it's not him being obtuse and failing to recognize the significance of what's happened.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这并不是他装糊涂、未能认清所发生事情的重要性。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: There's an apocryphal exchange.
sentences.zh: 有一个未经证实的传闻。

sentences.en: Somebody comes in to tell him this in the evening, another duke, and tells him the Bastillus 4 and Louis is supposed to have said, is it a revolt?
sentences.zh: 傍晚时分，另有一位公爵进来把这事告诉他，并告诉他巴士底狱失守了，路易据说曾问过，这是一场叛乱吗？

sentences.en: And the guy said, no, sire, it is a revolution.
sentences.zh: 那个人说，不，陛下，这是一场革命。

sentences.en: Again, I think that's too Hollywood, really.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我觉得这其实太好莱坞化了。

sentences.zh: 但第二天，即 7 月 15 日，他整个上午都在犹豫不决，拿不定主意该怎么办，但最终他决定应该亲自去向国民议会发表讲话。

sentences.en: He goes in with no guards, with no retinue, just with his two brothers, and he says, obviously things in this capital are totally out of control.
sentences.zh: 他没有带卫兵，没有随从，只带着他的两个兄弟走了进去，并说道，很明显，首都的事情已经彻底失控了。

sentences.en: I'm going to withdraw all troops.
sentences.zh: 我将撤回所有军队。

sentences.en: Please help me.
sentences.zh: 请帮帮我。

sentences.en: He says, help me to assure the salvation of the state.
sentences.zh: 他说，帮我确保国家的拯救。

sentences.en: Help me to send a delegation to Paris to sort things out.
sentences.zh: 帮我派一个代表团去巴黎收拾残局。

sentences.en: And the deputies are really impressed by this.
sentences.zh: 代表们对此印象深刻。

sentences.en: They're moved by it.
sentences.zh: 他们为此感动。

sentences.en: They start cheering and brilliant.
sentences.zh: 他们开始欢呼，太棒了。

sentences.en: The king has shown his willingness to work with us to recognize, you know, our importance.
sentences.zh: 国王已经表现出愿意与我们合作，以承认，你知道的，我们的重要性。

sentences.en: And he's clearly going to play decently.
sentences.zh: 而且他显然会好好配合。

sentences.en: So at two o'clock that afternoon, they send this great cortege, this procession of deputies and carriages to Paris.
sentences.zh: 所以在那天下午两点，他们派出了这个庞大的仪仗队，由代表和马车组成的队伍前往巴黎。

sentences.en: And they are led by the president and the vice president of the National Assembly.
sentences.zh: 他们由国民议会的主席和副主席率领。

sentences.zh: 主席是一位名叫让-西尔万·巴伊的天文学家。

sentences.zh: 副主席是我们美国听众会熟悉的一位男士，拉法耶特侯爵。

sentences.en: Tremendous character.
sentences.zh: 了不起的人物。

sentences.zh: 你喜欢拉法耶特侯爵吗，汤姆？

sentences.zh: 他是个富有的贵族。

sentences.en: He went for his gap year.
sentences.zh: 他去度间隔年了。

sentences.en: Very bravely.

sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，
